items.title: AWS Nitro Sandboxes: Hardware-enforced workload isolation on Amazon EKS
items.summary: AWS Nitro Sandboxes bring hardware-enforced, per-pod isolation to Amazon EKS. Every sandboxed pod runs in its own lightweight virtual machine with the isolation of a dedicated Amazon EC2 instance and the simplicity of a Kubernetes pod. Learn how it works and how to turn it on with a one-line change to your pod spec.
items.creator: Carlos Santana
